# revision of a record fails the build. build_reference.py rebuilds from this file
# search rbcL: txid<genus>[Organism:exp] AND (rbcL) AND 450:5000[SLEN], whole hit set paged, sorted locally

# library: 14,173 sequences, 7,040 from Barcode UK and 7,133 from GenBank for Plant Atlas
# taxa, covering 173 families, 1,026 genera and 2,899 species of the British flora.
# The authors' library also covered the garden's own living collection, read from its
# IRIS BG catalogue. That catalogue is not ours to redistribute, so no target here comes
# from it and the library is buildable from public sources alone. See docs/replica.md.
